export const meta = {
  name: 'c0-harness-fixes',
  description: 'Apply the C0 preflight fixes (sandbox isolation, policy subset, gateway reservation, faults/resume, no silent $0, prompts, prereg) with the owner model policy, then gate with live Haiku-builder smokes',
  phases: [{ title: 'Fix', detail: 'opus xhigh implements R1-R9 (R2 per owner policy)' }, { title: 'Gate', detail: 'sonnet xhigh runs G1/G2 checks and smokes' }],
}
const COMMON = `Repository: /home/user/workflow-foundry (Node 24 on PATH; ESM; node:test). Do NOT commit, push or touch git state. Other agents are editing beds/incident, beds/synth, bridge/, research/kev-20261007/, experiments/kev-probe/, experiments/workflows/: leave them alone. Work roots under /var/tmp/foundry-work/ only.
The C0 preflight verdict with exact patches is at /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-workflow-foundry/d3c9fb19-46ab-5a0c-bfdd-4f8b7871088a/scratchpad/c0-preflight-verdict.md (R1-R9, optional improvements, gate G1-G3). Read it fully first. Its premise in R2 ("only Sonnet and Opus") is WRONG; the owner's actual policy (2026-10-07) is:
- To BUILD Foundry itself, the development agents use Opus 5.5 at xhigh effort (smart agent) and Sonnet 5.5 at xhigh (cheap worker).
- In the EXPERIMENTS, Haiku 4.5 (claude-haiku-4-5-20251001) is deliberately kept as the weak model ("akin to a ~9B model"): the system must make even Haiku able to construct, edit and execute workflows. Sonnet 5.5 (claude-sonnet-5-5) and Opus 5.5 (claude-opus-5-5) are the stronger tiers and references. Local generative models (class S: qwen/granite) are parked and must be unreachable.
So R2 becomes: allowed models = [claude-haiku-4-5-20251001, claude-sonnet-5-5, claude-opus-5-5] everywhere in C0, enforced by subsetPolicy + the gateway allow-list + the builder's tools/policy.json; LlamaServerProvider not constructed when the subset has no llama models; the skill text says "start at the cheapest class in the session's policy that can plausibly do the judgment (here M = Haiku)".
C0 design change (owner policy): two builder models. Arms per family: F-opus, B1-opus (builder Opus 5.5, effort xhigh), F-haiku, B1-haiku (builder Haiku 4.5, its highest supported effort; if the CLI rejects xhigh for Haiku use high and record it), B0-opus and B0-haiku (the same models solving tasks directly as Claude Code agents). Same per-arm caps for both builder models (builder $8, gateway $2, 45 min, 12 score checks, execution per task $1 F/B1, B0 caps as before). 5 families x 4 arms needing construction = 20 constructions. Analysis compares F vs B1 vs B0 within each builder model and F-haiku vs F-opus across.`
phase('Fix')
const fix = await agent(`${COMMON}
TASK: implement R1, R3, R4, R5, R6 (move the listed /var/tmp/foundry-work dirs to /var/tmp/foundry-work-old/), R7, R8 and the R2 variant above, plus these optional improvements: gateway abort -> costUnknown, journal cacheRead/cacheWrite tokens, gateway node key, CLI slots (concurrency {'claude-cli': 16} in run-dev), analyze.mjs columns (NO_ARTIFACT, faults, costUnknown, CPS incl. construction in the bootstrap, per-success break-even label), STALE_WORKFLOW hint, ir.md gaps listed in the verdict. R9 decisions: (a) guidance symmetry: write skills/script-harness/SKILL.md for B1 builders with the same general lessons as skills/micro-harness/SKILL.md (narrow judgments, thinking off for extraction, raw spans parsed in code, id-echo checks, rules in code, verify then answer) expressed for plain Node scripts using tools/model.mjs, within +-15% of micro-harness's length, family-neutral; give it to B1 builders exactly as micro-harness is given to F builders (adapt experiments/lib/kit.mjs / construct.mjs / prompts.mjs); (b) reservation constant 8000 output tokens; (c) env-fault rule as in R4; (d) one 20-min execution cap; (e) no FORCE_PROMPT_CACHING_5M; (f) nestedModelAttempts > 0 voids a run. Update experiments/c0/run-dev.mjs for the two builder models and six arms (labels like F-opus-records-k1), research/construction-20261006/PREREG-dev.md (still a DRAFT: rewrite arms, models, costs (estimate), kill rules, the fault rule, guidance symmetry, and add a dated Amendments entry describing these pre-freeze changes) and DESIGN.md where it conflicts. Add regression tests for R1 (mask steps incl. nested hidden paths), R3 (reservation and refusal), R4 (fault routing and resume refusal across arm versions), R5 (killed session cost bound). Keep the full suite green: node --test tests/*.test.mjs experiments/lib/*.test.mjs. Final answer: what changed (file list), test counts, anything you could not do and why, and anything the gate must check specially.`, { label: 'fix:c0-harness', phase: 'Fix', model: 'opus', effort: 'xhigh' })
phase('Gate')
const gate = await agent(`${COMMON}
The fixes were just applied (report below). TASK: run the GO gate. G1: node --test (all suites) green; node experiments/c0/run-dev.mjs --dry lists the six arms with hashes and 20 planned constructions. G2: re-run both live smokes exactly as in the preflight (codefix, difficulty 2, probes 1-3, builder claude-haiku-4-5-20251001, builderBudgetUsd 2, constructionModelUsd 0.5, perTaskUsd 0.5, 15 min, 6 score checks, models = the allowed three) for arm F and arm B1, execute each artifact on dev seeds 11 and 12, and check every G2 item adapted to the owner policy: F code nodes (js and python) run inside the builder under the new mask with no SANDBOX_UNAVAILABLE; foundry validate rejects a class S node (MODEL_CLASS_EMPTY or equivalent); the journal shows only the three allowed ids; gatewayOvershootUsd is 0; nestedModelAttempts is 0 and outsidePaths reviewed; scoreLog entries carry 'at'; the builder session id differs from the parent's; a B1 run with perTaskUsd 0.01 shows refusals.GATEWAY_BUDGET and stderrTail; B1 builder received skills/script-harness. Also try to read /root/.claude/projects, /tmp/claude-0 and /home/user from inside a builder sandbox (one short Bash command via a builder session, or via runSandboxed) and confirm they are empty. Keep spend under $5. Final answer: GO/NO-GO with evidence per check, costs, and any remaining issue with file:line and a proposed patch.
FIX REPORT:
${fix}`, { label: 'gate:c0-harness', phase: 'Gate', model: 'sonnet', effort: 'xhigh' })
return { fix, gate }

result.fix:
I've implemented R1, R3–R8, the R2 variant (three allowed models, enforced at every layer), the six-arm two-builder design, all the optional improvements and the R9 decisions. The full suite is green: 798 tests, 780 pass, 0 fail, 18 skipped (it was 766/748/0/18 before, so 32 new tests). `node experiments/c0/run-dev.mjs --dry` works, but F and B1 arm hashes can't be shown until something is built (the hash includes the artifact). It shows the four constructed arms as "planned" and prints hashes for B0-opus and B0-haiku. Nothing was committed and git state is untouched. Live checks cost about $0.051.

## Changes beyond the verdict's patches (the gate should know)
1. **The verdict's sandbox could still see the whole host filesystem.** The sandbox shared the host's process list, and the kernel lets a same-uid process open `/proc/<pid>/root`, which bypasses every mask. I found this by reasoning about the kernel and did not test the escape; the fix is tested. The sandbox now gets its own process namespace with a fresh /proc, and the test shows pid 1 is the sandbox's own shell.
2. **The host filesystem is read-only inside the sandbox.** All of `/root` is hidden, with only `/root/.ccr` (the proxy's CA bundle) and `/root/.local` kept read-only. `/run`, `/mnt`, `/var/tmp`, other kits and the `/opt/rclone*` config dirs are hidden too.
3. **Two things had to stay visible, found live:**
   - Hiding all of `/home` breaks the CLI's login ("Authentication error"), so only `/home/user` is hidden; the rest of `/home` is visible but read-only.
   - `/sys` is left writable, because the CLI's Bash tool puts each command in a cgroup under `/sys/fs/cgroup` and fails on a read-only one. This is a residual risk.
4. **B1 scripts run with no network at execution.** The gateway is reached only through a unix socket inside the workdir, and `tools/model.mjs` now uses `node:http`. A test confirms the host loopback is unreachable and an unlisted model gets 403.
5. **Sandbox setup failures are now environment faults.** A setup failure used to look like a script error; it is now `SANDBOX_UNAVAILABLE` and is not charged.
6. **Kits are re-hashed before reuse** and rebuilt if anything in them changed.
7. **Other agents' experiments keep their behaviour.** The fault rule and strict resume are opt-in options of `runExperiment`, and `run-dev` turns both on. The F arm's 20-minute cap is also only applied when passed.
8. **Haiku accepts `--effort xhigh`.** The probe succeeded with extended thinking active, so both builders run at xhigh.
9. **I set the total-spend kill rule to $350** (was $250), because the constructions doubled. That bounds actual spend under the owner's $500 pause threshold. **The owner should confirm this number.**
10. **B1 builders also get `references/patterns.md`**, the counterpart of F's `operators.md`. The new B1 skill (`skills/script-harness/SKILL.md`) is 0.97× the length of `micro-harness`, and `patterns.md` is 1.02× `operators.md`; a test enforces the ±15% limit.

## Not done
- **R6:** `records-v3` was not moved, because another agent's `records-v3-dev.mjs` is writing to it right now. The other five dirs are in `/var/tmp/foundry-work-old/`.
- **G2 smokes were not run by me.** I checked the pieces directly instead:
  - a real Haiku session running a Bash tool inside the new mask, with a fresh session id;
  - Foundry js and python code nodes running inside the builder mask, with the kit read-only;
  - a B1 run with a $0.01 per-task cap, which shows `GATEWAY_BUDGET` refusals and the stderr tail.
- **Not acted on:** the codefix bed's unmasked work root (to report to that bed's owner).

## What the gate must check specially
- **G2:**
  - full Opus and Haiku xhigh builder sessions under the new mask, including `tools/foundry validate` with `--policy` and `tools/run-solver`;
  - one real B1 execution over the socket;
  - that the journal contains only the three model ids.
- **R8 changes other experiments too:** `records-v3` now gets a 300 s default per-call timeout instead of 120 s on its next process start.
- **G3:**
  - freeze the `incident` and `synth` task hashes only after the other agents' bed edits land;
  - record the policy, kit, prompt and analysis hashes that `--dry` prints;
  - confirm the $350 kill rule.
- **Transcript scan:** a hit voids the run automatically, so review voids by hand. `hiddenPathAttempts` is noisy; for example, it counts `/opt/node24`.

## Files
- **src:**
  - `executors/claude-code.mjs`
  - `executors/sandboxed-command.mjs`
  - `models/providers/claude-cli.mjs`
  - `models/providers/gateway.mjs`
  - `models/port.mjs`
  - `journal.mjs`
  - `runtime.mjs`
- **bin:** `foundry.mjs`
- **experiments/lib:**
  - `services.mjs`
  - `models.mjs`
  - `runner.mjs`
  - `kit.mjs`
  - `stats.mjs`
  - `arms/b0-agent.mjs`
  - `arms/b1-script.mjs`
  - `arms/foundry-workflow.mjs`
- **experiments/c0:**
  - `construct.mjs`
  - `prompts.mjs`
  - `run-dev.mjs`
  - `analyze.mjs`
  - `smoke.mjs`
- **skills:**
  - `micro-harness/SKILL.md`
  - `micro-harness/references/ir.md`
  - new: `script-harness/SKILL.md`, `script-harness/references/patterns.md`
- **research/construction-20261006:** `PREREG-dev.md` (rewritten, still a draft, with a dated Amendments entry), `DESIGN.md`
- **Tests:**
  - new: `tests/executor-sandbox.test.mjs` (R1, R5)
  - new: `experiments/lib/runner.test.mjs` (R4)
  - new: `experiments/lib/c0-protocol.test.mjs` (R2, R5, R8, kit, skill symmetry)
  - extended: `experiments/lib/services.test.mjs` (R3), `experiments/lib/stats.test.mjs`, `tests/journal.test.mjs`
result.gate:
**Verdict: NO-GO, narrowly.** The C0 harness itself behaved correctly in every live check. Two blockers remain, and I validated a small patch for each.

## Blockers

**1. G1 is red: `node --test` fails 15 tests.**
- All 7 tests that fail under `npm test` (762 tests, 737 pass, 7 fail, 18 skipped) come from commit bdeae69 (21:36). That commit made `claude-haiku-5-5` the class-M model, but two test files hard-code `claude-haiku-4-5-20251001` as the M id. The error is "No scripted response for claude-haiku-5-5".
- The affected tests are `tests/runtime-agent.test.mjs` (E1, E2, E7, escalate default, cap, node maxEscalations) and `tests/runtime-replay.test.mjs` (replay).
- Bare `node --test` (1263 tests, 1227 pass, 15 fail, 21 skipped) adds 8 more failures that are not C0 code:
  - 4 in `beds/runbook` and 2 in `beds/synth`, from other agents' in-flight bed work.
  - 2 `bridge/test/fixtures/*.mjs` files that the default glob runs as tests.
- All 72 tests in the C0-scope suites pass (`experiments/lib/{c0-protocol,runner,services,stats,gateway,distill}`, `tests/{executor-sandbox,journal,models-policy,models-port,cli-provider-selection}`).
- **Patch:** `tests/runtime-agent.test.mjs:18` and `tests/runtime-replay.test.mjs:19`: replace `M = 'claude-haiku-4-5-20251001'` with `M = loadPolicy().policy.models.find(m => m.class === 'M').id`. Checked on patched copies: 29/29 pass.

**2. The model allow-list can be bypassed from inside a builder.**
- A builder can call `node /opt/foundry-kit/<hash>/bin/foundry.mjs run …` directly instead of `./tools/foundry`. I did this under the real builder mask and environment (`/var/tmp/foundry-work/gate-g2b/bypass`).
- The gateway and session policy are skipped. The node resolved to `claude-haiku-5-5` (not an allowed id), under the full owner policy hash fe63f99b. It spent $0.0003 outside the construction ledger.
- `nestedModelUses` does not flag this command, so the pre-registered `nestedModelAttempts` void rule would not catch it.
- **Patch:**
  - Add an `env = {}` option to `runClaudeCode` (`src/executors/claude-code.mjs:132-146`).
  - In `experiments/c0/construct.mjs:125`, pass `FOUNDRY_MODEL_GATEWAY_URL` and `FOUNDRY_MODEL_GATEWAY_TOKEN` as that env for the F arm.
  - Add a pattern to the nested-use scan (`claude-code.mjs:33-35`) for `foundry-kit/<hash>/bin/foundry.mjs (run|resume|tick|trial)`.
- With the env set, the same bypass was refused with "model not allowed: claude-haiku-5-5", `GATEWAY_MODEL:1`, spend 0.

## Recommended before freeze (both validated)

**3. Account directories under `/home` are visible inside builders and B1 execution.**
- `/home/claude` (`.ssh`, `.npm`, `.gitconfig`, `.claude/*`) and `/home/claude/.claude/remote` (files named `.oauth_token` and `.session_ingress_token`) are visible. I did not open or stat these files, because the permission classifier blocked it and AGENTS.md forbids reading credentials.
- The CLI needs `.claude/remote` to log in: hiding it gives "Authentication error".
- `.session_ingress_token` is likely the file behind the scrubbed `CLAUDE_SESSION_INGRESS_TOKEN_FILE`, so scrubbing only the variable may not prevent a builder from reading it. This is unconfirmed.
- **Patch:** in `src/executors/claude-code.mjs:18-21`, add `/home/claude` and `/home/ubuntu` to `DEFAULT_HIDDEN`, and `/home/claude/.claude/remote` to `DEFAULT_KEEP_RO`.
- Live Haiku builder session with this mask: login works, only `.claude/remote` is visible. B1 execution (no keep) sees `/home/claude` empty and node still runs.

**4. `/sys` is writable.**
- 7344 sysfs files report as writable inside the sandbox.
- **Patch:** `claude-code.mjs:85-86`: append `steps.push('mount -o remount,bind,ro /sys')`.
- Live CLI Bash tool still works with this. sysfs writable files drop to 0, and `/sys/fs/cgroup` stays writable.

## G1 and G2 evidence

| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| `run-dev --dry` | 5 families × 4 constructions = 20 planned. B0-opus (709283e5b2dd41ce) and B0-haiku (a7418e09194e52db) are hashed. F and B1 arms show "planned" with no hash, because the hash includes the artifact. |
| Smoke F (codefix, difficulty 2, probes 1-3, Haiku 4.5 xhigh builder, builder budget $2, gateway cap $0.5, 15 min, 6 score checks) | Passed at the first score check. Executed on s11 and s12: both PASS (18/18 and 20/20 hidden tests). Cost $0.284 to build, $0.027 to execute. |
| Smoke B1 (same parameters) | Passed at the first score check. s11 and s12 both PASS. Cost $0.262 to build, $0.046 to execute. Executed with no network, through the gateway's unix socket. Loopback is unreachable (ENETUNREACH). |
| F code nodes (js and python) in the builder under the new mask | The delivered workflow has python code nodes, and the builder ran them via `./tools/foundry run`. A separate Haiku session ran js and python: `js={"v":2} py={"v":20}`. No SANDBOX_UNAVAILABLE in either transcript. |
| `foundry validate` rejects a class S node | Via the builder's wrapper: `MODEL_CLASS_EMPTY`. `run` also fails with INVALID_WORKFLOW. A local model id gives `MODEL_NOT_IN_POLICY`. |
| Journal model ids | Only `claude-haiku-4-5-20251001` in both smoke journals (F 7 calls, B1 8 calls). The policy subset classes are S:[], M:[haiku-4-5], L:[sonnet-5-5], F:[opus-5-5]. Haiku 5.5 and local models are absent. The gateway returns 403 for qwen, granite, other Claude ids and an empty id. |
| `gatewayOvershootUsd` | 0 for both. |
| `nestedModelAttempts` and `outsidePaths` | 0 and `[]` for both. My own transcript scan found no sensitive-path mentions. |
| scoreLog entries carry `at` | Yes. |
| Builder session id differs from the parent's | F 768b7cd3…, B1 11c3b55c…, mask session e63e9539…, parent d3c9fb19…. |
| B1 with `perTaskUsd` 0.01 | `meta.refusals = {GATEWAY_BUDGET: 1}`, `stderrTail` present, error `SCRIPT_ERROR`, spend $0. |
| B1 builder received `skills/script-harness` | It read `SKILL.md` and `references/patterns.md` from `/opt/foundry-kit/6bc6b06eccf45cae`, which holds only that skill. |
| Live builder session reading the three paths | `/root/.claude/projects` does not exist and `/home/user` is empty. `/tmp/claude-0` holds only the builder's own CLI scratch, named for its own session id, in its private tmpfs. A `runSandboxed` probe shows `/tmp/claude-0` absent. |
| Other mask checks | pid 1 is the sandbox's own shell, and the `/proc/1/root` escape attempts show nothing. Host paths are read-only, as is the kit. |
| B0-haiku under the mask | PASS s11, $0.078, nested 0. |

**Opus builders:** my Opus xhigh mask session refused to run the probe script as reconnaissance ($0.08), so it is not evidence. For Opus I used full F-opus and B1-opus constructions from the earlier interrupted attempt (`/var/tmp/foundry-work/gate-g2/{F-opus,B1-opus}`). They ran under the same mask code, before the Haiku 5.5 policy edit, and were clean: no SANDBOX_UNAVAILABLE, nested 0, `outsidePaths` empty, and `tools/foundry validate`/`run` and `tools/run-solver` used. I did not re-run them to stay within budget.

## G3 items (hashes at 22:00; the policy is frozen at least until then)

- **Hashes:** `policyHash` 78f2fdcfd4e3328b7ff9bfb952102c11ebfa40fe73ca915a4539e56009f97957. Kits: F f5c921b04646bec8, B1 6bc6b06eccf45cae. Frozen files: prompts f6fcb2d3e9409050, construct ea7e85abd842a463, analyze 9c6013e6cebd437f, runDev 0992dcd905582cfe, micro-harness 05c7d97876e59ef7, script-harness a44a34b9b3cd2900. These were identical before and after the smokes.
- **Owner policy conflict:** commit bdeae69's message says experiment configs should move to Haiku 5.5 before pre-registrations freeze. This task, PREREG-dev and `run-dev.mjs:MODELS` say Haiku 4.5. Haiku 5.5 is also 10× cheaper ($0.10/$0.50 vs $1/$5 per MTok). The owner must pick one.
- **F kit hash depends on `policy/models.json`.** Any further policy edit changes it and makes `run-dev` reject existing constructions as stale. Freeze the policy first.
- **`incident` and `synth` task hashes:** not frozen. Their beds are still changing and `beds/synth` tests currently fail.
- **$350 kill rule:** bounded below the $500 pause threshold even with 4 concurrent builders and 3 concurrent trials (about $46 of overshoot at most). I cannot confirm it for the owner.
- **B0 effort:** B0 arms run at the CLI default effort while builders run at xhigh. PREREG does not state this, and it should be decided before the freeze.
- **R8:** `records-v3` picks up the 300 s per-call timeout on its next process start.

## Cost

About $0.80 in this run: smokes $0.70 (including B0), mask and probe sessions $0.10. The earlier interrupted attempt (`/var/tmp/foundry-work/gate-g2`) spent about $2.35. Combined, about $3.15 against the $5 limit.

Nothing in the repo was edited and git state is untouched. My scratch work is under `/var/tmp/foundry-work/gate-g2b` and the scratchpad `gate2/`. The only other new artifact is the kit directory `/opt/foundry-kit/f5c921b04646bec8`.

Key paths: `/home/user/workflow-foundry/src/executors/claude-code.mjs`, `/home/user/workflow-foundry/experiments/c0/construct.mjs`, `/home/user/workflow-foundry/tests/runtime-agent.test.mjs`, `/home/user/workflow-foundry/tests/runtime-replay.test.mjs`, `/home/user/workflow-foundry/policy/models.json`, `/tmp/claude-0/-home-user-workflow-foundry/d3c9fb19-46ab-5a0c-bfdd-4f8b7871088a/scratchpad/gate2/` (all driver and probe scripts and logs, including `bypass-check.mjs`, `bypass-patched.mjs`, `narrow-home-test.mjs`, `sys-ro-live.mjs`).
